pictures.author: Nima raevant
pictures.observations: Whole500x603 standing view: ten-base open tapering monument with diagonal crossing pale stone ribbons/deep side faces, broad turquoise/ivory tiled diamond/petal surfaces and genuinely open elongated diamond/triangular gaps. Upper ribbons curve into a rounded narrow crown. Low central grave marker and folded triangular perimeter panels on paved ground. No pixels/calligraphy traced.

pictures.author: Armin (آرمین)
pictures.observations: Closer960x640 exterior: repeated diagonal crossings and deep pale stone sides, large turquoise/white tiled fields inside narrow pale borders, lower pointed tile panels, rounded crown and tall truly open diamond gaps. Confirms shape/tile contrast rather than an opaque generic dome; vegetation/base partly obscure lower context.

pictures.author: Vathlu
pictures.observations: Whole960x643 upward ceiling view resolves the coverage gap: ten petal-like tiled upper fields/crossing pale ribs, closed small decorated central rosette and ten dark sky openings around it. Original repeated floral/lozenge geometry is used as a restrained substitute; no copied calligraphy or floral atlas.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Standing Omar Khayyam Mausoleum: ten paired curving/crossing pale stone ribbon legs around broad turquoise/ivory tiled lower diamonds and upper petals, true elongated open gaps and rounded ten-petal crown/small closed central rosette. Deep ribbon sides, metric shared tile/stone surfaces and original restrained geometric leaf/lozenge decoration imply the tile fields without reproducing inscriptions. Separate ten feet, occupied circular paving/short perimeter step, low central grave marker and simplified folded edge panels. No opaque generic tower/dome, traced calligraphy/photo atlas, furnished visitor facilities, trees/temporary equipment or whole garden.
